CustomTab.description: Opens the Vista 360 admin builder (c/v360AdminBuilder). The API name still says Console because it was created for c/v360AdminConsole, which the builder replaced; a tab cannot be renamed, only deleted and recreated, and doing that would re-grant its visibility in every permission set and break every existing link for the sake of a string nobody sees. The label is what users read, and it is accurate.
CustomTab.label: Vista 360 Admin
